environment_basis.scope: live concentric_study repo on this machine

layers.name: substrate_truth
layers.goal: Prove the machine substrate and selected backends are healthy before any task-level diagnosis.
first_actions: run host health summary
confirm selected backends
confirm required classes are ready
layers.stop_condition: Do not move up-stack until required host capability classes are healthy or explicitly classified as unavailable.

layers.name: architecture_conformance_truth
layers.goal: Verify that the live architecture/governance model is truthful before diagnosing module placement or structural regressions.
first_actions: run architecture conformance in check mode
confirm no write mutation in check mode
review monitored debt separately from unexpected drift
layers.stop_condition: Do not patch runtime architecture to satisfy stale documentation or stale artifacts.

layers.name: task_surface_truth
layers.goal: Confirm that the live page/app surface is actually the surface the agent thinks it is working on.
first_actions: capture the front window
confirm page mode and step
verify no blocking overlays
verify actual work area and current surface state
layers.stop_condition: Do not debug perception or action semantics against the wrong page/app state.

layers.name: perception_truth
layers.goal: Validate that the project is seeing the intended front surface and aligning overlays or geometry correctly.
first_actions: confirm screenshot is of the intended front window
confirm overlay alignment
compare screenshot-based geometry to DOM/window geometry
layers.stop_condition: Prefer geometry truth over brittle screenshot heuristics when the former is available.

layers.name: interaction_action_truth
layers.goal: Determine whether the intended semantic action and its native execution path are the right primitive for the live widget or surface.
first_actions: identify intended semantic action
verify mapping to action-space primitive
confirm target identity and coordinates from the live surface
layers.stop_condition: Do not escalate force before proving the missing capability is mechanical rather than semantic.

layers.name: recovery_refinement_truth
layers.goal: Verify that recovery changed state, not just produced a plausible diagnosis.
first_actions: inspect diagnostic screenshot and prompt
inspect selected recovery action
check whether postcondition verification ran
inspect visual monitor checkpoints around the recovery
layers.stop_condition: A recovery is not successful unless it produces a meaningful state transition.

layers.name: verification_truth
layers.goal: Ensure that success/failure judgments are being asked and measured correctly.
first_actions: inspect decomposed constraints
inspect checkpoint schedule if present
check whether verification mode matches the task
layers.stop_condition: Do not weaken final verification to make metrics look green.

layers.name: artifact_reproducibility_truth
layers.goal: Confirm that traces, screenshots, exports, and conformance artifacts tell the truth and are reproducible.
first_actions: confirm trace and manifest correspond to the same run
confirm exported target matches visible page/canvas
confirm read-only verification paths stay pure
layers.stop_condition: Do not reason from artifacts that have not been proven to reflect the current live surface.

layers.name: claim_discipline_documentation_truth
layers.goal: Prevent debugging against a fictional or overstated version of the project.
first_actions: compare strong claims to live tests
compare docs to current imports and entrypoints
label claims by support tier
layers.stop_condition: Do not debug the project the docs wish existed; debug the one the tests and code prove exists.

layers.name: dead_weight_signal_to_noise_truth
layers.goal: Reduce diagnosis noise from memo/demo/artifact density without deleting anything during the debugging step.
first_actions: classify files as current/legacy/experimental/generated/stale candidate
prefer authoritative docs and current artifacts
ignore orphaned demo outputs during first-pass diagnosis unless directly relevant
layers.stop_condition: Do not let stale artifacts or memo sprawl set the debugging agenda.
